answer: Faking thousands of identities becomes a frozen tundra of idle capital, since every duplicate must post the same bond or be pruned when the challenge tide rises. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed influence, and peers randomly challenge via a verification inlet that samples historical contributions. Attackers pay linearly in locked stake while honest agents recover theirs, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0240's threat model.
